Identifying which stocks to remove from a portfolio is as critical as selecting which ones to buy. In this video, we analyse ten specific categories of companies that frequently underperform or pose significant risks to long-term capital.
We examine the fundamental and behavioural red flags that investors should monitor, ranging from management styles and capital structures to industry-specific volatility. Use this guide to audit your holdings and ensure your investment strategy remains aligned with sustainable wealth creation.
